heading: Powers
lead: The corporation has only the powers provided in its bylaws and articles of incorporation filed in each State in which it is incorporated.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 2070636:1902.June 1, 1982, Pub. L. 97–192, § 2, 96 Stat. 109. The words “(hereinafter referred to as the ‘corporation’)” and “and subject to the laws of such State or States” are omitted as unnecessary.
